svg.text: Phase 2 · step 6j · A vehicle's Timeline tab, and Overview's latest fuel-ups: two options for the Timeline
Newest first. Each event opens its page. A corrected event stays, marked, with its correction beside it; only the correction's values count.
A · A list grouped by month: one row per event, the numbers on a second line
Overview Timeline Maintenance Fuel Documents Setup
+ Easy to scan; months give a sense of time.
+ The correction sits right above what it
corrects, which is dimmed and indented.
+ Same rows on a phone, just narrower.
− The numbers don't line up in columns.
B · A table on wide screens (columns line up), cards on phones
+ Numbers line up: easy to compare
− A corrected row is struck through,
Both options · Overview: the Latest fuel-ups panel, and each meter's latest reading
Wide · Overview (the panels that fill in this milestone)
Fuel economy arrives with Phase 5's reports.
The other Overview panels (ready to use,
coming due, squawks) stay as they are
